T:
Stand tall with core braced and a soft bend in the elbows. Raise the weight forward to shoulder height, then lower slowly without swinging or using the hips.

Primary movers: anterior deltoid.
Secondary movers: lateral deltoid, upper trapezius, serratus anterior.

Stand tall holding the bar or dumbbells with straight arms. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears without rolling them, pause briefly, then lower under control.

Primary movers: upper trapezius.
Secondary movers: levator scapulae, rhomboids; forearm flexors grip.

Stand side-on to a low cable with a soft elbow. Raise the handle out to shoulder height, leading with the elbow, then lower slowly against the cable's pull.

Primary movers: lateral deltoid.
Secondary movers: supraspinatus, upper trapezius; core stabilises.

Squat with your chest lifted and weight through mid-foot. As you stand, drive the weight up to shoulder height in one smooth sequence, then reset under control.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus, anterior deltoid.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors, lateral deltoid; core stabilises throughout.

Hold the dumbbells with a neutral grip, palms facing in and elbows by your sides. Curl without swinging, then lower slowly to full extension.

Primary movers: brachialis, biceps brachii.
Secondary movers: brachioradialis, forearm flexors.

Working one arm at a time, keep the upper arm still and curl through a full range without swinging. Lower slowly to full extension before the next rep.

Primary movers: biceps brachii.
Secondary movers: brachialis, brachioradialis, forearm flexors.

Stand on one leg with the other foot resting behind you on a bench. Lower until the front thigh is near parallel, keeping the knee tracking over the foot, then drive up through the front heel.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors, gluteus medius; core and ankle stabilise the single-leg position.

Take an underhand grip on the bar with elbows pinned at your sides. Push down to full extension, keeping the wrists neutral, then return under control without letting the elbows drift forward.

Primary movers: triceps brachii (medial head emphasis).
Secondary movers: anconeus; forearm flexors grip, core stabilises.

Curl one arm at a time with the upper arms still, alternating sides. Supinate as you lift, squeeze at the top, then lower under control to full extension.

Primary movers: biceps brachii.
Secondary movers: brachialis, brachioradialis, forearm flexors.

Hinge forward with a flat back and pin the upper arm alongside your ribs. Extend the elbow until the arm is straight, squeeze, then return under control without the shoulder dropping.

Primary movers: triceps brachii (long and lateral heads).
Secondary movers: posterior deltoid stabilises; core and erector spinae hold the hinge.

Hold the dumbbell with a neutral grip, palm facing in and elbow close to your ribs. Curl across your body toward the opposite shoulder, then lower under control.

Primary movers: brachialis, biceps brachii.
Secondary movers: brachioradialis, forearm flexors; core resists the swing.

Stand tall with a soft bend in the elbows. Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height to the front, then out to the side, lowering under control between reps. No swinging or shrugging.

Primary movers: lateral and anterior deltoid.
Secondary movers: supraspinatus, upper trapezius; core stabilises.

Sit with both feet centred on the platform, hips and lower back flat against the pad. Lower under control until the knees reach about ninety degrees, then press away without locking out.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors.

Sit with the pad across your thighs and the balls of your feet on the platform. Push up onto your toes through a full range, pause at the top, then lower slowly until you feel a stretch.

Primary movers: soleus.
Secondary movers: gastrocnemius, tibialis posterior, foot intrinsics.

Support your weight with your hands, chest tall. Lower until the elbows reach about ninety degrees, keeping them tracking back rather than flaring out, then press up to full extension.

Primary movers: triceps brachii.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, lower pectoralis major.

Elbows pinned at your sides, push the rope down and separate the ends at the bottom. Squeeze at full extension, then return under control without the elbows drifting forward.

Primary movers: triceps brachii (lateral head emphasis).
Secondary movers: anconeus; core stabilises the trunk.

Stand tall with a shoulder-width underhand grip, elbows tucked close to your sides. Curl the bar by bending at the elbow only, keeping the torso still, then lower under control to full extension.

Primary movers: biceps brachii.
Secondary movers: brachialis, brachioradialis, forearm flexors; core resists the lean back.

Bar on your upper back, step into the lunge and lower the back knee toward the floor with your torso upright. Drive through the front heel to return, keeping the knee tracking over the foot.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors, erector spinae; core braces under the bar.

Take the bar on your upper back, brace, and squat to depth. Hold the bottom position for a full three seconds without relaxing, then drive up. The pause removes momentum and exposes any loss of position.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors, erector spinae; core braced throughout the hold.

Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest height, elbows tucked. Sit down between your hips to depth, chest tall and knees tracking over your toes, then drive through mid-foot to stand.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: adductors, hamstrings, erector spinae; core braces the trunk.

Sit in the press with one foot centred on the platform. Lower under control until the knee reaches about ninety degrees, then press away without locking out. Keep your hips and lower back flat against the pad.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors; the working side's hip stabilisers resist rotation.

Hold the bar overhead with elbows close to your head. Lower behind the head under control into a stretch, then extend to full lockout without letting the elbows flare.

Primary movers: triceps brachii (long head emphasis).
Secondary movers: anconeus; core braces against the overhead load.

Dips with added resistance. Keep your chest tall and elbows tracking straight back, lower to about ninety degrees, then press to full extension without locking harshly.

Primary movers: triceps brachii.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, lower pectoralis major; core braces.

Seated or standing, start with palms facing you at shoulder height. Press overhead while rotating your palms to face forward, then reverse the path on the way down. Keep ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.

Primary movers: anterior and lateral deltoid.
Secondary movers: medial deltoid, triceps brachii, upper trapezius; core stabilises.

Lie back on an incline bench with dumbbells at chest height, elbows at roughly forty-five degrees. Press up and slightly together, then lower under control to a comfortable stretch.

Primary movers: upper (clavicular) pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, triceps brachii; rotator cuff stabilises.

Dips with your feet supported and added resistance across the lap. Lower until your elbows reach about ninety degrees, keeping them tracking back rather than flaring, then press up.

Primary movers: triceps brachii.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, lower pectoralis major; core stabilises the trunk.

With the rope overhead and elbows close to your head, extend the arms fully, then lower under control into a deep stretch behind the head without flaring the elbows.

Primary movers: triceps brachii (long head emphasis).
Secondary movers: anconeus; core resists the rib flare.

Hold the lunge near its bottom position and pulse through a short range without standing fully. Keep the front knee tracking over the foot and your torso upright throughout; time under tension is the stimulus.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors, gluteus medius; core resists rotation.

Stand square to the cable with the handle at shoulder height or above, pressing down and across on a decline path. Resist the rotation the single-sided load creates.

Primary movers: lower (sternal) pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, triceps brachii; obliques and core resist rotation.

Step forward into a lunge, lowering the back knee toward the floor with your torso upright. Drive through the front heel to bring the back leg through into the next step.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors, gluteus medius; core stabilises each step.

Hold a dumbbell at chest height and stand on the Bosu with feet hip-width. Sit down between your hips, keeping your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes, then drive up. The unstable base demands constant foot and core control.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: adductors, hamstrings, erector spinae; ankle stabilisers and core work hard on the unstable surface.

Stand tall between the cables with a soft elbow bend. Bring the handles together in front of your chest in a wide arc, squeeze briefly, then let them open under control.

Primary movers: pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, serratus anterior; core resists the pull backward.

Lie flat with a soft bend in the elbows and the dumbbells above your chest. Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a stretch across the chest, then bring them back together without pressing.

Primary movers: pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid; rotator cuff stabilises the open position.

Dips with your feet supported on a med ball to share the load. Lower until the elbows reach about ninety degrees, keeping them tracking back, then press up to full extension.

Primary movers: triceps brachii.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, lower pectoralis major.

From a push-up position, shift your weight toward one hand as you lower so that side takes more of the load, then alternate. Keep your hips square and level.

Primary movers: pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, triceps brachii; obliques and core resist rotation.

Lie flat with a grip slightly wider than shoulders, feet planted. Lower the bar under control to the mid chest, elbows tucked to roughly forty-five degrees, then press back up.

Primary movers: pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, triceps brachii; lats stabilise the shoulder.

Bar resting on the upper back, feet shoulder-width. Brace, sit down and back to depth with your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes, then drive through mid-foot to stand.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors, erector spinae; core braces the trunk.

Hands on the Bosu in a push-up position. Perform the push-up, then draw one knee across toward the opposite elbow before resetting. Keep your hips level throughout.

Primary movers: pectoralis major, obliques.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, triceps brachii, rectus abdominis, hip flexors.

Hands on the Bosu, body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower under control until your chest is near the dome, then press away. The unstable base increases the stability demand.

Primary movers: pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, triceps brachii; core and serratus anterior stabilise.

Sit or stand tall with dumbbells at shoulder height, elbows under the wrists. Press straight overhead without flaring the ribs, then lower under control to ear level.

Primary movers: anterior and lateral deltoid.
Secondary movers: triceps brachii, upper trapezius, serratus anterior.

Lie flat with dumbbells at chest height, elbows at roughly forty-five degrees. Press up and slightly together, then lower under control to a comfortable stretch.

Primary movers: pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, triceps brachii; rotator cuff stabilises.

Primary movers: upper (clavicular) pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, triceps brachii.

Primary movers: pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, triceps brachii; core and serratus anterior stabilise.

Primary movers: upper (clavicular) pectoralis major.
Secondary movers: anterior deltoid, triceps brachii; core holds the line.

A controlled stretch for the muscles of the back. Move into the position slowly, breathe out as you ease deeper, and never force range.

Primary movers: latissimus dorsi, erector spinae.
Secondary movers: rhomboids, middle trapezius.

Forearms supported, palms facing down. Lift the bar by extending the wrists through a full range, then lower slowly under control.

Primary movers: wrist extensors (extensor carpi radialis and ulnaris).
Secondary movers: brachioradialis.

Forearms supported, palms facing up. Curl the bar up by flexing the wrists through a full range, then lower slowly, allowing a controlled stretch at the bottom.

Primary movers: wrist flexors (flexor carpi radialis and ulnaris).
Secondary movers: finger flexors.

Feet shoulder-width, arms forward for balance. Sit down and back to depth under control, chest tall, then drive through mid-foot to stand. Tempo work makes the lowering phase the point.

Tempo: control the lowering phase and avoid rushing the turnaround. The slow portion is the point.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors, erector spinae.

Lunge with one foot on the Bosu, lowering under control with your torso upright. The unstable surface forces continuous foot and hip correction, so keep the movement slow and deliberate.

Primary movers: quadriceps, gluteus maximus.
Secondary movers: hamstrings, adductors, gluteus medius; ankle stabilisers and core work hard on the unstable base.

Breathing: exhale through the effort, inhale as you return. Do not hold your breath.
